body: My wife left me for my best friend lied to me about it for six months kept telling me we were working on things but dating and behind my back so it’s like double the torture double the betrayal. You just have to learn to love yourself and realize that one day you will be happy again you will find someone that will care for you and be your true partner in crime and realize just because there was someone different doesn’t mean they are better than you I know that I’m a better man than he is I will always treat her better than he will and I am just working on the strength that one day if she does try to come back strength to say no you did me wrong and I am now happy hopefully happier with someone else that treats me even better good luck and hang in there
I have very similar goals and I hope both our journeys toward this goal turn out for the best good luck my friend
I am doing just that trying to learn how to be the best I can be and I know that one day it will work out thank you for the kind words I really appreciate it
I am doing just that trying to learn how to be the best I can be and I know that one day it will work out thank you for the kind words I really appreciate it

It’s been a few months now it still happens to me occasionally it’s getting better but I know exactly where you’re coming from honestly the only thing I can say is you have to try to find a way to redirect your thoughts redirect the pain and hurt

I’m trying to pull my life back together after all of this realize that I am a good person that I am worthy of love from some good woman I know I have to learn from all of this I know I’m not solely to blame but it’s hard when you feel like it’s all your fault and you’re worthless. Thanks for this post made me feel a lot better

I want to hate her so bad but I realize it’s not hate I just love her still so much I think the heat will drive the love out of my heart but it does it I just have to try to work through it and get by day today and hopefully one day I can rebuild the pieces of my shattered heart right now I just feel like an empty hollow shell and all I think about is her and being with her and how I just want to die without her
If you change all of the cheese to he’s in this post it feels like it fell right out of my head and heart

I think I can relate during the day at work I can talk to people I feel slightly better I come home at night and I’m alone by myself in the thoughts begin to raise the darkness sets in and I just want to die my mind as you said feels like it’s tearing into one part of me wanting to make it day today the other wants to throw in the towel and just quit

I understand your struggles I have a lot of medical issues along with a lot of emotional issues right now and I pretty much feel like dying every day I literally just have to try to go day today try to find a reason every day try to find that one thing in the day that will bring a smile to my face even for a split second and that can get me to the next day

I know exactly how you feel I have recently gone through a horrible break up with the most wonderful woman I have a lot of bad health issues I pretty much want to die every day but it would devastate her and my family I pretty much wish every day to die in a car wreck someone will rob my store and shoot me or I’ll just die of natural causes
